gaps.valueSet: Rules 5-7 generic tests with tissue, blood, or cerebrospinal-fluid specimen constraints
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen predicate, and the corresponding HL7 specimen value sets are unavailable; the source's specimen-specific test-name branches remain implemented

gaps.valueSet: Rules 8 and 9 numeric antibody result greater than zero
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no numeric laboratory threshold predicate; coded-positive, organism-result, and abnormal-interpretation branches remain implemented
SEM_V1 cannot represent a fetus or infant delivered to a particular pregnant person or constrain that person's infection timing to gestation or six months before conception; TOX-R10 is omitted
the source identifies death-certificate evidence, but SEM_V1 has no death-certificate evidence
